diff --git a/reproduce_issue.py b/reproduce_issue.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..04df87b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/reproduce_issue.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+from pypika import Query
+from pypika.dialects import MySQLQuery, MSSQLQuery
+
+# Basic query with distinct
+q = Query.from_('abc').select('foo').distinct()
+print(f"Basic query: {q}")
+assert "SELECT DISTINCT" in str(q), f"Expected SELECT DISTINCT, got {str(q)}"
+
+# MySQL query with distinct
+q = MySQLQuery.from_('abc').select('def').distinct()
+print(f"MySQL query: {q}")
+assert "SELECT DISTINCT" in str(q), f"Expected SELECT DISTINCT, got {str(q)}"
+
+# MSSQL query with distinct
+q = MSSQLQuery.from_('abc').select('def').distinct()
+print(f"MSSQL query: {q}")
+assert "SELECT DISTINCT" in str(q), f"Expected SELECT DISTINCT, got {str(q)}"
+
+# Multiple columns with distinct
+q = Query.from_('abc').select('foo', 'bar').distinct()
+print(f"Multiple columns: {q}")
+assert "SELECT DISTINCT" in str(q), f"Expected SELECT DISTINCT, got {str(q)}"
